ai.seo_question: What does the phrase "Majlis akhar" with an incomplete narrator chain indicate in a hadith text?
ai.summary: This excerpt is only a brief heading followed by an incomplete narrator reference. It indicates the beginning of another session and preserves part of an isnad, but the matn is not present in the supplied text.
